sanskrit_verse:
धनं वेदान् भिषक्सिद्धिं कुप्यं गाअप्यजाविकम् ।
अश्वानायुश्च विधिवद्यः श्राद्धं संप्रयच्छति ॥१.२६७॥
transliteration: dhanaṃ vedān bhiṣak-siddhiṃ kupyaṃ gā apy ajāvikam / aśvān āyuś ca vidhivad yaḥ śrāddhaṃ saṃprayacchati // YajñS_1.267
sph_interpretive_translation: One who lawfully offers Śrāddha bestows wealth, Vedic knowledge, medical mastery, fertile cows, goats, sheep, horses, and extended life span.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from ritual compliance with Sanatana Dharma
Causation arises through dharmic offering aligned with cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by ability to perform śrāddha
Restoration logic operates via reciprocal alignment with ancestral lineage
Consciousness alignment occurs when offerings sustain generational continuity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs śrāddha THEN agent receives dharmic entitlements including health, progeny, and material abundance
IF śrāddha performed WITHOUT adherence to vidhi THEN no entitlement granted
IF śrāddha omitted due to neglect THEN ancestral disalignment triggers diminished capacity in lineage
IF śrāddha executed with full sankalpa THEN restoration of ancestral blessings is ensured
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning inheritance or ancestral rights, Supreme Court shall recognize śrāddha performance as prima facie evidence of dharmic stewardship. Non-performance may indicate forfeiture of ancestral claims unless mitigated through corrective completion process.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between śrāddha observance and prosperity through uninterrupted flow of pitṛ-tattva. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sustained lineage integrity. Responsibility lies not in punitive consequence but in completion obligation. Reality remains non-punitive; consequences reflect natural dharma-flow disruption.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śrāddha completion protocol under qualified priest supervision
Assign lineage reconciliation task to responsible heir within 30 days
Restore ancestral connection through purified offering procedure
Realign consciousness through sankalpa affirmation and mantra repetition
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. This verse enacts Dharma through conscious offering. Justice restores lineage integrity without inflicting punishment. Reality aligns with consciousness. Dharma is thus established.
